errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the breakdown of time costs before efficient deployment
errors.evidence: The description states the chart shows 'time costs before efficient deployment', which is an interpretation derived from the external caption, not from the visual information in the chart itself (which has no title). The prompt explicitly says to avoid interpretation.

errors.text_span: The segments are visually ordered from largest to smallest.
errors.evidence: The two segments are not ordered by size in a standard way (e.g., clockwise or counter-clockwise from a starting point). The larger slice is at the bottom and the smaller slice is at the top, which does not represent an ordering from largest to smallest.
